name: comp-27
title: Search Input With Loader
description: A labelled search field with a magnifier inside its left edge and a microphone inside the right. While a query is being entered the magnifier briefly becomes a spinning ring before settling back.
use: A search field that queries as you type and needs to show results are being fetched.
avoid: The microphone is a plain submit button with no speech wiring, so it only looks like voice input.
a11y: The spinner has a status role and both icons are labelled, but the mic does nothing and the spin ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A label sits above a rounded dark search field on a black stage. A small magnifier sits inside the left edge, a microphone icon inside the right, and a grey Search... placeholder runs between them; typing adds a native clear cross before the mic.
behaves: Typing swaps the magnifier for a spinning ring for about half a second, then restores it, while the query fills the field and a clear cross appears. The clip catches the spinner at pri and later shows pricing table settled with the magnifier back.
customise: The label and placeholder are fixed in the file; the 500ms delay, spinner and icon colours are set there, and typing drives the value.
weight: light: One field, two icons and a timer; the spin runs only during the brief loading window.
